"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/number-of-elapsed-seconds-between-two-times/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

3986. Number of Elapsed Seconds Between Two Times

You are given two valid times startTime and endTime, each represented as a string in the format "HH:MM:SS".

Return the number of seconds that have elapsed from startTime to endTime.

Example 1:

Input: startTime = "01:00:00", endTime = "01:00:25"
Output: 25
Explanation:
endTime is 25 seconds ahead of startTime.

Example 2:

Input: startTime = "12:34:56", endTime = "13:00:00"
Output: 1504
Explanation:
endTime is 25 minutes and 4 seconds ahead of startTime, which equals 1504 seconds.

Constraints:

    startTime.length == 8
    endTime.length == 8
    startTime and endTime are valid times in the format "HH:MM:SS"
    00 <= HH <= 23
    00 <= MM <= 59
    00 <= SS <= 59
    endTime is not earlier than startTime
"""


class Solution:
    def secondsBetweenTimes(self, startTime: str, endTime: str) -> int:
        def to_seconds(t: str) -> int:
            h, m, s = map(int, t.split(":"))
            return h * 3600 + m * 60 + s

        return to_seconds(endTime) - to_seconds(startTime)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.secondsBetweenTimes("01:00:00", "01:00:25"))  # 25

assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("01:00:00", "01:00:25") == 25
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("12:34:56", "13:00:00") == 1504

assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("00:00:00", "00:00:00") == 0
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("00:00:00", "23:59:59") == 86399
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("23:59:58", "23:59:59") == 1
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("12:00:00", "12:00:00") == 0
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("00:00:01", "00:00:02") == 1
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("00:00:00", "00:01:00") == 60
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("00:59:59", "01:00:00") == 1
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("10:10:10", "10:10:10") == 0
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("05:30:15", "05:30:45") == 30
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("22:22:22", "22:22:23") == 1
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("00:00:00", "00:00:59") == 59
assert sol.secondsBetweenTimes("23:00:00", "23:59:59") == 3599
